title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #14 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these should you do first when learning a mantra? (1 mark)
   A. Guess the words
   B. Listen to a teacher or recording for correct sounds
   C. Say it very fast
   D. Skip the words

2. How can you show a Mandir in a drawing? (1 mark)
   A. A rectangle hall with a pointed spire
   B. A circle only
   C. A river
   D. A zigzag line

3. Which goddess is Saraswati? (1 mark)
   A. Goddess of fire
   B. Goddess of war
   C. Goddess of knowledge and learning
   D. Goddess of the river Ganga

4. What are bhajans? (1 mark)
   A. Exams
   B. Devotional songs
   C. Maps
   D. Sports

5. What is aarti? (1 mark)
   A. Eating
   B. Painting
   C. Reading a map
   D. Waving a lamp in front of the murti while singing

6. What does sakha mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth
   B. Mother
   C. God
   D. Friend

7. What does mata mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Friend
   B. Father
   C. Mother
   D. Teacher

8. What does Asteya include besides not stealing things? (1 mark)
   A. Not eating
   B. Not using another's time or ideas without asking
   C. Not smiling
   D. Not walking

9. Which is fair play in a game? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Pushing
   C. Tripping others
   D. Following the rules even when nobody is looking

10. Which statement about integrity is true? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for teachers
   B. It is only for big things
   C. It is only for adults
   D. It includes small daily choices

11. What does the story of Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo teach? (1 mark)
   A. Rich people are wrong
   B. Honest earnings are best
   C. Wealth is proof of goodness
   D. Cheating pays

12. Which is a sign of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in a test
   B. Keeping your promises
   C. Telling lies
   D. Taking a friend's pen

13. What did the Buddha say about a person's words? (1 mark)
   A. They should be true, kind and helpful
   B. They should be false
   C. They should be loud
   D. They should be rude

14. What should passengers do before boarding a vehicle? (1 mark)
   A. Run alongside it
   B. Push others
   C. Wait for the vehicle to stop
   D. Jump onto it

15. What does it mean to pay your fare honestly? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid paying
   B. Hide from the conductor
   C. Pay less
   D. Pay the right amount and take your change

16. What should you do if you feel dizzy during yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore it
   B. Hold your breath
   C. Stop at once
   D. Continue faster

17. In Sasankasana, where do you rest your forehead? (1 mark)
   A. On the mat
   B. On the wall
   C. On a chair
   D. On your knees

18. Which three things does yoga join? (1 mark)
   A. Books, pens and paper
   B. Water, soil and air
   C. Body, breath and mind
   D. Rivers, trees and fire

19. Why should Kapaal Bhaati and Bhastrika be done gently by children? (1 mark)
   A. They are very slow
   B. They are painful always
   C. They are active and need care
   D. They cannot be done

20. What does Vajra mean in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Bellows
   B. Moon
   C. Hare
   D. Diamond or thunderbolt

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. What is integrity? (2 marks)

22. List three ideal practices of a passenger when boarding. (3 marks)

23. Write a short paragraph on why honesty is the best policy. (5 marks)

24. Describe the day of prayers for a child. (5 marks)

25. Give two signs of integrity. (2 marks)

26. Name two parts of a Mandir. (2 marks)

27. Explain why yoga should be practised with an expert. (4 marks)

28. Explain why a child should understand the meaning of a prayer. (4 marks)

29. Describe three rites and rituals in a Mandir. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Listen to a teacher or recording for correct sounds
   Listening helps us say the right sounds.

2. A — A rectangle hall with a pointed spire
   A hall with a spire is a simple model.

3. C — Goddess of knowledge and learning
   Saraswati is the goddess of learning.

4. B — Devotional songs
   Bhajans are songs of prayer.

5. D — Waving a lamp in front of the murti while singing
   It is a prayer with a lamp.

6. D — Friend
   Sakha means friend.

7. C — Mother
   Mata means mother and pita means father.

8. B — Not using another's time or ideas without asking
   It includes respecting others' things and ideas.

9. D — Following the rules even when nobody is looking
   Fair play is integrity.

10. D — It includes small daily choices
   Small choices count.

11. B — Honest earnings are best
   Honest work is valued.

12. B — Keeping your promises
   Keeping promises shows honesty.

13. A — They should be true, kind and helpful
   Right speech.

14. C — Wait for the vehicle to stop
   Wait until it has stopped.

15. D — Pay the right amount and take your change
   Honesty includes paying fares.

16. C — Stop at once
   Stop and rest.

17. A — On the mat
   The forehead rests on the mat.

18. C — Body, breath and mind
   Yoga joins these three.

19. C — They are active and need care
   They are active exercises.

20. D — Diamond or thunderbolt
   Vajra means diamond or thunderbolt.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Being honest and doing what is right even when nobody is watching.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honesty and 1 mark for doing right when unseen.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wait for the vehicle to stop, form a line and do not push, let children and elders go first, pay the fare honestly (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: An honest person is trusted, feels calm, makes friends, keeps a good name and helps the community. A liar loses trust. Examples such as returning lost money or not cheating support the paragraph.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the topic, 2 marks for reasons, 1 mark for an example, 1 mark for a clear conclusion.

24. (5 marks)
   Answer: In the morning, the Gayatri Mantra and the Saraswati Vandana before study; at midday before meals, Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva; in the evening, thanks to God. Also sit calmly and fold hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part of the day, 1 mark for manners.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Telling the truth, keeping promises, returning what is not yours, not cheating (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: Entrance, main hall, inner room (garbhagriha), spire (shikhara), bell (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: An expert shows the correct posture, corrects mistakes, prevents strain of the back or knees, and knows when to stop.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four points.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Understanding makes the prayer come from the heart, helps us remember it, and helps us live by its message. Rushing without meaning makes it only a habit.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point, up to 4.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Darshan, aarti, prasad, bhajans, ringing the bell (any three, with a short description).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
